clips.start_words: There are two basic kinds of juice machines
clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who just bought a cheap juicer for a New Year cleanse - anxiety they bought the wrong machine and are losing the benefit.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau broke down the two kinds of juice machines people use for a juice fast or cleanse, on his show.

A centrifugal juicer spins a blade fast enough to create heat and friction while it pulls the juice out. A press or gear juicer squeezes slowly instead, with no spinning blade at all.

His point: that heat and friction can damage the enzymes you're juicing for in the first place, even though the juice in the glass looks exactly the same.

His own pick is the slow, gear-driven press, every time.

Which kind of juicer is sitting in your kitchen right now?
